_cast_channel_server._note: CAST channel event bus — HTTP server at http://127.0.0.1:9200. Start with: cast-channel-start.sh

_endpoints.POST /publish: Receive a JSON event from hook scripts
_endpoints.GET /events: Return last N events as JSON (?limit=10)

_cast_channel_server._upgrade_path: This will be registered as a proper MCP server when the MCP spec supports local HTTP servers natively
